# GrowthSent
> Simple SEO & Website Analytics for Developers.

GrowthSent provides tools and services designed to help developers and website owners understand, monitor, and improve website health, discoverability, search performance, and growth.

## Core Pages
- https://www.growthsent.com/ (Home & Web Scanner)
- https://www.growthsent.com/pricing (Pricing & Plans)
- https://www.growthsent.com/privacy (Privacy Policy)
- https://www.growthsent.com/terms (Terms of Service)
